site.subtitle: One craft only — handloom. Each weave gets its own page, its own story, its own scroll.

designs.title: Moonloom Stripe
designs.summary: Cloud-soft handloom cotton with graphite stripes that catch morning light.
designs.detail: Woven on a pit loom in dense cotton. Washed six times for that lived-in drape — still crisp enough to hold a fold.
designs.origin: Handwoven in Karur. Graphite warp, mist weft, matcha selvedge stitch.

designs.title: Saffron Mist
designs.summary: Warm saffron warp meets mist-grey weft — sunshine, softened on the loom.
designs.detail: A limited handloom run with floating selvedge and tonal embroidery along the cuff.
designs.origin: Handwoven in small batches. Saffron yarn dyed with natural plant color.

designs.title: Ink Garden
designs.summary: Botanical motifs on charcoal handloom cotton — gallery quiet, bed soft.
designs.detail: Natural dyes and hand-blocked motifs on a slightly irregular handloom weave that photographs like art.
designs.origin: Woven first, then block-printed by hand so every sheet lands a little differently.

designs.title: River Check
designs.summary: Oversized checks in river blue and foam — throw it, layer it, live in it.
designs.detail: Lightweight handloom khadi with a brushed face. Designed to look intentional on a messy bed.
designs.origin: Spun and woven by hand. Soft check that still reads sharp on camera.

designs.title: Petal Grid
designs.summary: A micro-grid of blush petals on bone handloom cotton — romantic, never fussy.
designs.detail: Percale handfeel from a dense handloom sett. Matte finish, soft hand, clean lines.
designs.origin: Bone cotton warp with blush petal weft accents, woven end to end by hand.

designs.title: Loom Noir
designs.summary: Near-black handloom with a satin-sheen stripe that only shows when you move.
designs.detail: For the moody bedroom. Dense handloom weave, cool touch, maximal drama with zero clutter.
designs.origin: Near-black yarn, hand-picked for depth. The stripe appears only in motion.

updates.title: Studio notes: why we wash six times
updates.body: New handloom arrivals feel stiff. Ours don’t. Every NikkiNind sheet is washed, dried, and pressed in a slow cycle before it ever hits a shoot — so the first night already feels like night forty.

updates.title: Dropping Night Ritual — a quieter handloom palette
updates.body: Graphite, fog, and one sharp matcha stitch. Night Ritual is pure handloom for rooms that glow after midnight and still look editorial at noon.

updates.title: Handloom only — and every weave gets a page
updates.body: NikkiNind is not a decor dump. We only make handloom textiles, and each piece now lives on its own page with its own scroll story — loom, origin, palette, feel.
